craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala-śānta of sealed date; vyabhicāri śama at signed finished work. Sanskrit-first: ṣaṭṣaṣṭi-kṛṣṇa-mārgaśīrṣa (SIXTY-SIXTH/DARK-NINTH/MĀRGAŚĪRṢA — kept; colophon dates kept honestly, L3-HANDCRAFT rule 5); abhinavaguptaḥ (BY-ME-ABHINAVAGUPTA — signature kept; praised-passive). Rows: 10 (date left standing — year/fortnight/month kept, never modernized to bare CE), 1 (‘praised’ closes — stuta last: the work ends in its own verb). Close: ‘was Śiva praised’. Rupture: line-break (when stated, then who — date, then hand). Rejected: naming beyond seal — killed: seal is the verse; ‘composed’ for praised — killed: stuta kept praised (the verse praises, not merely makes). Read aloud: IN the-SIX-ty-SIXTH-year, NINTH of-THE-dark-FORT-night — … BY-me, ab-hi-na-va-GUP-ta, WAS-śI-va-PRAISED.

lines: In the sixty-sixth year, ninth of the dark fortnight —
in Mārgaśīrṣa, by me, Abhinavagupta, was Śiva praised.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭṣaṣṭinām eke varṣe navamyām asite | mayā 'bhinavaguptena mārgaśīrṣe stutaḥ śivaḥ

reads_against.argmap: When and by whom was Śiva praised? → Dated seal: 66th year, 9th dark, Mārgaśīrṣa, Abhinavagupta.
